items.title: Bank Stocks Back In Focus As Wells Fargo And JPMorgan Face Tougher Rules
items.summary: Bank stocks just landed back in Washington’s spotlight as Democrats take both chambers of Congress, and that political shift could reshape how big lenders make money, take risk, and deal with regulators. For investors, moments like this often reset expectations quickly, so those on the sidelines risk reacting late.
